top_signals.title: API Shows Substantial Crude Oil, Gasoline Inventory Builds
top_signals.summary: The American Petroleum Institute (API) estimated that crude oil inventories in the United States rose by 5.3 million barrels in the week ending November 13. In the week prior, US crude oil inventories rose by 9 million barrels.  Commercial crude oil inventories excluding the SPR have lost more than 49 million barrels over the last 31 weeks, but has gained 1.6 million over the course of this year, according to API data, which has been kept in check in part thanks to draws from the SPR.   For the week ending November 13, 3.1 million barrels…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: UK Carbon Capture Keeps Advancing Despite Critics
top_signals.summary: The United Kingdom just took a major step forward toward building one of the world’s biggest carbon capture and storage projects under the North Sea.
